title: Full UI iteration plan: all layered queues, supersessions and tally-consumer gaps
head: b6678ea9ba4a7cf0313ce83e0c0fc6b0e5c26d5b

reviews.classification: Full evolving UI/engine plan; actual supersession, scope and incomplete event/receipt consumer contract
reviews.disposition:
F1. Full975-line content review covers IT1–IT9, the complete R15–R32+/R3x/later queue and renumberings, WB1–WB9, Part0–10 router, NX1–NX46, the full WR01–WR99 uptake table, PX1–PX10, J1–J6, PV1–PV8, WX1–WX14, CTL1–CTL24, CZ1–CZ10, GU1–GU8, PP1–PP8/merge record, CB1–CB5, VP1–VP4, HZ1–HZ8, MB1–MB9, SU1–SU12 and FC1–FC20. This is layered chronology with local namespaces, not one current executable DAG. Keep original IDs and supersession rather than substituting numeric rank for actual dependencies. Its opening everything-proposed-until-played sentence cannot demote separately recorded user direction or impose human acceptance as product authority; AD32 and AD42 retain proposal/adoption and optional review boundaries.

F2. The plan corrects itself materially. NX20 limits reversals to owned changes, not whole shared files; NX26 resolves the early missing committed baseline; NX27 later marks registry/architecture integration landed. NX29 replaces separate placement hints with the layout spec, NX37 adopts existing factories rather than one invented universal signature, NX38 distinguishes mounting hand fixtures from safely capturing raw state, and NX40 removes the preview's old M3 dependency. R17's actual structural proof compares both sides with R17a. No old staged-deletion note, held merge, stale current worker or prerequisite commit is a new blocker or action in this reconciliation. AD51 qualifies older second-consumer-before-design thresholds: design from actual mechanisms, then test claimed reuse in a different case.

F3. Preserve consumer/storage distinctions. Global display preferences can enter the strict gameplay envelope, while panel/local layout/seen state uses browser storage and transient interaction uses neither. A control box does not change those owners by relocating a toggle. CB5 byte-identical export is valid for opening/closing presentation and layout controls; changing a gameplay-saved hide/order/options toggle may intentionally change its saved value and must preserve that semantics rather than falsely require all bytes unchanged. Dynamic panel-setting fallback must not overwrite a temporarily unavailable valid choice. Temporary ineligibility is not destructive unregister. Source/body/knowledge facts remain domain-owned; a projection version is not a save version.

F4. Keep stable-moment composition, actual text size, manual placement, useful task/quote/blocker/return and disclosure boundaries ahead of zero-slack aesthetics. WX12 no-wrap and FC19 roughly50%-used targets are proposed fit heuristics, not universal current gates. A long description/log can wrap or scroll locally while useful controls remain available. B248 records genuine R16/R20 gains and R18's one-row toolbar cost. The five-forced-measure500-DOM-row probe is not a full simulation benchmark. Preview closure/module counts and zero import-time writes/timers test their exact entry, not every panel. A hand-safe preview and branded screenshot do not authenticate native action, source law or sealed-raw-state capture.

F5. Current desktop1920/Mac/1536 at14/21px, prose-first independent panes and optional art qualify the historic1366 floor, full-height snapshot assumptions and source-derived skin. Old screen hardware/survey percentages are dated observations or inference, not freshly verified current market/hardware claims. Selected control labels preserve actual meaning: BGM means background messages, report categories were independent toggles, collapse is not saved reorder, Favorites is not auto-use, and saved favorite locations differ from browser layout. No unknown facts may leak through ordering, count, tab presence, true-identity filenames, class names, accessible labels or a copied raw fixture. Exact appraisal or other strong faculty works through its actual supported means under AD38.

F6. Keep later UI chronology intact: R21c home/awakening receipts qualify its queued missing-home row; R22b/c later record dormant-export leakage despite passing behavioral gates. FC11 replaces FC1 visible-letter tags, and FC13 permits by-kind display collapse with distinct named occurrences while letters-off, rather than erasing actor histories. R22c's report records missing live Stances proof and a hand-toggled fight-return check. The queue says R22b merged before R22c while R22c's report says built on the same unmerged branch; do not infer current integration from either planning phrase. Consult actual Git/receipt when integration matters. Historical PP merge records preserve their exact baseline, mixed timing-suite result and isolated reruns; no new merge, worker or message is authorized.

F7. FC15/FC16/FC18 have an unresolved data-consumer contract. R22's unsaved event snapshots are useful producers, but retained visible Reports are affected by filters, Stop combat log, Clear, category retention and display grouping. A damage/hit-rate ledger must state the actual event subscription, counting identity, observation scope, start/end/reset boundary and whether suppressed/cleared events still reach it. A visible-line count is not automatically every attack, and multiset RNG parity is not exact event-order proof. A five-hit survival estimate is a qualified extrapolation under actual current conditions, not guaranteed remaining life or future damage bounds. Loot this trip needs actual quantities/IDs/receipts, since one dynamic or merged loot line is not necessarily one item. Select an existing event/receipt owner or explicitly scope a partial observed tally; do not silently create duplicate rewards, truth telemetry or a new durable event store.

F8. Hundreds of opponents remain a consumer-triggered engine/world question. HZ's8/40/200 examples, pooled units, virtualization and grouped log are proposals, not canon maxima, measured capacity or permission to lose named injured/committed individuals when reducing detail. Wave total is not simultaneous population. Current ACR activity compression can preserve actual choices/outcomes/causes across detail changes without an all-pairs tick or invented equal-power cap under AD22. Under AD36/AD43 use the selected existing scenario/check at its assigned stage, not every historic harness or whole Cartesian product. This full review launches no runtime, source acquisition, prototype, agent, install, commit or push.
reviews.evidence: All975 input lines delivered in ranges1–135,136–275,276–415,416–555,556–695,696–835,836–975. Linked code/book/source/screenshot/process/Git integration not freshly verified.
reviews.reopen: Selected executable UI/Encounter consumer: qualify actual event/loot observation and retention boundary, current input/ownership and compatibility. Do not launch the historical queue or inherit all proposed thresholds as gates.
